title: HTML ASCII - SCENE, OBJECT CREATOR
author: NatasBR
selftext:
I made a webpage that let's you create anything in ASCII 3D 

Static or animated objects, scenes with logic, dioramas, etc, just input a prompt (simple or detailed, like the first scene in the video, the prompt was "AI npc character, a robot in a diorama like scene, when I click on the space, a piece of trash appears, the robot takes the trash and keep moving randomly until next object is dropped") 

You can detail the entire scene as you wish, also a "free roam mode" where you can spawn created objects in the 3d environment some will even interact with each other

it has import and export function, files are also compatible with the mobile version I'm working on

Limited by the user custom API key

what do you guys think? It's already on GitHub, DM me and I will send the link
